findings.issue: Make targets call bare `python`, which does not exist on this machine outside the venv (exit 127). The pipeline only ran after I called .venv/bin/python directly. System python3 also lacks pyarrow.
findings.why_it_matters: `make all` fails unless the venv is activated. The README setup does say to activate it, so this is minor. The seed is fixed (HGB random_state=0) and requirements.txt is pinned.

findings.issue: Metrics are reported only for valid and test. Train scores are not reported, and the test set is never held out from model selection beyond fixed hyperparameters.
findings.why_it_matters: No tuning is done on test, so this is informational. The pipeline is clean on all four checks.
